apply_attempts_submit_audit_check.name: apply_attempts_submit_audit_check
apply_attempts_submit_audit_check.value: "apply_attempts"."status" not in ('waiting_confirmation', 'submitting', 'confirmed', 'not_confirmed') or "apply_attempts"."submit_granted_at" is not null

educations_end_after_start_check.name: educations_end_after_start_check
educations_end_after_start_check.value: "educations"."start_date" is null or "educations"."end_date" is null or "educations"."end_date" >= "educations"."start_date"

experiences_end_after_start_check.name: experiences_end_after_start_check
experiences_end_after_start_check.value: "experiences"."start_date" is null or "experiences"."end_date" is null or "experiences"."end_date" >= "experiences"."start_date"

profiles_salary_expectation_check.name: profiles_salary_expectation_check
profiles_salary_expectation_check.value: ("profiles"."salary_expectation_amount" is null or "profiles"."salary_expectation_amount" > 0) and ("profiles"."salary_expectation_period" is null or "profiles"."salary_expectation_period" in ('year', 'month', 'day', 'hour'))

profiles_work_preferences_check.name: profiles_work_preferences_check
profiles_work_preferences_check.value: ("profiles"."contract_type" is null or "profiles"."contract_type" in ('employment', 'b2b', 'either')) and ("profiles"."work_hours" is null or "profiles"."work_hours" in ('full_time', 'part_time', 'either')) and ("profiles"."work_mode" is null or "profiles"."work_mode" in ('remote', 'hybrid', 'onsite', 'any'))

users_parent_matches_role_check.name: users_parent_matches_role_check
users_parent_matches_role_check.value: ("users"."role" = 'super_admin' and "users"."parent_user_id" is null) or ("users"."role" <> 'super_admin' and "users"."parent_user_id" is not null)

users_login_credentials_match_role_check.name: users_login_credentials_match_role_check
users_login_credentials_match_role_check.value: ("users"."role" = 'account' and "users"."login_name" is null and "users"."password_hash" is null) or ("users"."role" <> 'account' and "users"."login_name" is not null and "users"."password_hash" is not null)

users_display_name_matches_role_check.name: users_display_name_matches_role_check
users_display_name_matches_role_check.value: ("users"."role" = 'account' and "users"."display_name" is null) or ("users"."role" <> 'account' and "users"."display_name" is not null)

users_block_audit_fields_check.name: users_block_audit_fields_check
users_block_audit_fields_check.value: ("users"."blocked_at" is null and "users"."blocked_by" is null) or ("users"."blocked_at" is not null and "users"."blocked_by" is not null)
